SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ts_hour,
  ROUND(wtmp_c * 9.0/5.0 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_t >= 450
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND yt > 0
GROUP BY doy
ORDER BY doy

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / COUNT(*), 1) as avg_yt_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 61 AND fish_date_doy <= 91
GROUP BY doy
ORDER BY doy DESC

SELECT 
  index_id,
  value,
  avail_doy,
  avail_season
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 2 AND avail_doy >= 85
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC

SELECT 
  report_date_doy as doy,
  yt_local,
  yt_all,
  wt_all,
  text
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_season = 2 AND report_date_doy >= 80
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as yt_total,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as yt_avg
FROM trips
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
HAVING fish_date_doy >= 80 AND fish_date_doy <= 120
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT 
  landing,
  boat,
  cls,
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as freq_last_30_days
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 62 AND fish_date_doy <= 91
GROUP BY landing, boat, cls, fish_date_doy
HAVING freq_last_30_days > 0
ORDER BY landing, boat, cls
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  boat,
  cls,
  fish_date_doy,
  SUM(yt) as yt_total,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as yt_avg
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 92 AND fish_date_doy <= 97 AND yt > 0
GROUP BY boat, cls, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_total DESC
